title: Zionist Expansion w/ Sam Kimball
author: CounterPunch.org
content:
This week on CounterPunch Radio, Erik Wallenberg and Joshua Frank talk to
journalist Sam Kimball about Israel's illegal occupation of Syria, Zionist
expansion in Lebanon, and the US/Israel war on Iran.

Read Sam Kimball's piece, [Zionist Expansion: A First-Hand Account of Israel’s
Illegal Occupation of Southwestern
Syria](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/01/27/a-first-hand-account-of-
israels-illegal-occupation-of-southern-syria/).
